title: Add local collected-post review and detail-enrichment exclusion controls
approved_decision: Add a minimal Extension list of human-collected root posts with non-destructive exclude, re-enable, and re-enrich controls backed by the loopback Source Store.
scope: list collected canonical root posts from local Source Store data
filter by detail state including excluded
append an exclusion/re-enable audit trail without deleting source evidence
prevent excluded identities from pending-list and batch claims
allow explicit re-enrich to re-enable and queue an identity
render local post metadata and controls in the Extension options page
forbidden: physical deletion of source observations or identities
